name: FAMMA
description: An open-source benchmark for financial domain multilingual multimodal question answering, evaluating LLMs on complex reasoning questions requiring advanced financial knowledge across 8 subfields, with questions in multiple languages and including non-text data like charts and tables.
reputation: A recent open benchmark introduced in the literature, but it is still relatively new and not yet as widely adopted as long-established finance QA benchmarks.
notes: Benchmark has two versions: FAMMA-Basic (1945 questions) and FAMMA-LivePro (103 questions, held-out answers for contamination-free evaluation).
